machineScope.reason: Encrypted filesystem staging is capped at 1024 frames on the owner-signed local route. Envelopes are removed only after accepted payloads are durable in the existing replicated journal; receipts only after authenticated custody proof is journaled. Lookup requests are reproducible from sender preparations and answered from current intake. Reclamation follows successful replication and ownership/stop checks. Authoritative sends, intake, reads and custody evidence remain in the existing journal through compaction and host replacement; no agent memory is deleted.

requiredFacts.criticality: Exact owner signature, private topic share, peer identity, current role grant, full durable cause, known zero-cost operation, claim bounds, ownership, stop and held-secret checks. Peer statements cannot grant authority.
requiredFacts.preservesInput: Existing hook trace retains requests; the encrypted journal retains admitted cause and peer payloads. Failed or unknown dispatch retains its stable preparation; no automatic resend. Recoverable staging is reclaimed after replication; accepted payloads and authenticated custody proofs stay in the encrypted journal.
